name: rosetta-zero-to-the-zero-power
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

write_line("there is no exponentiation operator, so the library answers")
write_line("as doubles: {System.Math.pow(0.0, 0.0)}")
write_line("as big integers: {bigint.pow(0n, 0)}")
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

write_line("there is no exponentiation operator, so the library answers")
write_line("as doubles: {System.Math.pow(0.0, 0.0)}")
write_line("as big integers: {bigint.pow(0n, 0)}")
output:
there is no exponentiation operator, so the library answers
as doubles: 1
as big integers: 1
